entities.name: Sages of Minorad
entities.description: Group of sages led by five native Dominarian planeswalkers who gathered in Minorad's spires.

entities.name: Silver Ernes
entities.description: Sent across Dominaria by the council of elders to gather its greatest minds.

entities.name: The Gathering
entities.description: The first gathering of the Sages in 3000 AR.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Planeswalker who attacked the Summit of Minorad, fearing it would disrupt his revenge.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Weapon Ravidel threatened to use on the sages.

entities.name: Embereck
entities.description: Ash Warlord who left vowing revenge on Ravidel.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Sage forced into servitude and exiled.

entities.name: Grenfell Mor
entities.description: Sage forced into servitude and exiled.

entities.name: Altair of Coloni
entities.description: Sage forced into servitude and exiled.

entities.name: Liana
entities.description: Sage forced into servitude and exiled.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Helped by the sages to destroy the Sylex.

entities.name: Planeswalkers' War of Corondor
entities.description: War in which several sages were present.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Continent where the sages were exiled.

events.summary: The sages first gather in 3000 AR, year 1 of the Reckoning of the Sages of Minorad.
Ravidel attacks the Summit of Minorad, threatening to butcher the sages with the Golgothian Sylex.
events.quote: He threatened to butcher all Minorad's sages with the Golgothian Sylex

events.summary: Embereck leaves vowing revenge while four sages are forced into servitude and exiled to Corondor.
events.quote: were forced into servitude and exiled to a certain region on Corondor

events.summary: The group, save Embereck, gathers again to help Jared Carthalion destroy the Sylex.
events.quote: gathered again to help Jared Carthalion destroy the Sylex

relations.quote: to help Jared Carthalion destroy the Sylex
